title: RuntimeGuard: Attestation-Bound Runtime Enforcement with eBPF for AI Workloads — code and experimental package
description: Complete experimental package: Kubernetes operator (RuntimeSecurityPolicy / RuntimePlacementEvidence CRDs), BPF-LSM node agent, kind and Azure deployment tooling, attack and measurement scripts, and raw data, processed results, summaries and exclusions for every experiment (admission-to-release closure, observation completeness, revocation, pod recreation, scale, performance, BPF-LSM enforcement, control-plane tampering).
